features: 🌼Language of Daisies: Innocence, cheerfulness, and New Beginnings. This pure-look daisies create a cozy and spring atmosphere for your house party, wedding, banquet, office desk, store windows, etc.

🌼SIZE: 3 bunches/set, each small bunch contains 9 stems and 21 flowers. Height: approx. 12 inch tall. Flower head size:1.8"~2.4". Perfect for mini flower vase under 12 inch height. Cute décor for office desk, counter, or wall mounted shelf.
🌼LIFELIKE MATERIAL: decorative flowers and leaves are made of silk textile, stems are made of non-toxic plastic.

🌼DIY & EASY INSTALL: The flowers might be flatten or deformed due to shipping. With easy hand adjustment, the flowers will become vivid again. There are wires in the stems, you can bend or stretch them to fit your vase. Spray a little water and blow them tenderly will help to revive the petals. Let's enrich your aesthetic space right away.
🌼COLOR VARIATIONS: We offer up to 7 colors. Coordinate the space as you wish. Perfect match with baby breath, sunflowers, roses. Accent your living room, dining table, office cube as fresh as daisy!
